controls.blackMarketNote: Buy orders only: you sell against the best offer, which may disappear before you arrive.
controls.breedLabel: Breed the base animal instead of buying it
controls.breedNote: Replaces the grown animal’s market price with the cost of raising it yourself: horse and ox use the Farm Merchant’s fixed-price baby, discounting the chance that, once grown, it gives you a new baby back (78 to 87% by tier); giant stag, moose, direwolf, direboar, direbear, swamp dragon and mammoth use the cheapest baby another player is selling (they give no babies back). Cheapest available feed is added in every case. Raising takes 44 h (T3) to 284 h (T8) and silver/day doesn’t count that wait. The Fire-Winged Draco and the Spring Rabbit (event) have no real breeding cost to compute and don’t change.
controls.marketShareHint: What share of the daily sales volume you assume you can capture.
controls.stationRateHint: Silver Albion charges for crafting, per 100 nutrition consumed.
controls.journalsNote: You buy the item's tier empty journal, fill it with the craft's fame and sell it full. That profit is added to cost, net revenue and silver/day. Gear only: refining, alchemy and cooking fill no journal in the game.
